platforms.policy: bin/install refuses any platform not listed in published, before downloading anything, and prints what is available. This list is the single source of truth: bin/install's SUPPORTED variable and the README 'Platform support' table must both match it, and scripts/test.sh T3e asserts that they do.
platforms.darwin_caveat: macOS builds cannot bundle system libraries the way Linux can: libSystem and libc++ are supplied by the OS, so a macOS artifact is tied to the macOS version it was built on and cannot be made fully self-contained. Support will be scoped accordingly.

checksum_policy: sha256 must be a 64-char lowercase hex string or null. null means NOT BUILT. Never invent a checksum.

notes: extensions.redis = 2.2.8: phpredis 2.x is the last branch for PHP < 7 (official 2.2.8 release notes). phpredis 6.3.0 requires PHP >= 7.4.0 per PECL, so it cannot be reused for 5.4. Verified 2026-11-08.

extensions.swoole = 1.10.5 is the last 1.x release (2018-05-14). L2 2026-11-08 实测：在 PHP 5.4.45 上 phpize / configure / make 全通过，swoole.so 与 redis.so 都已装入制品（构建日志 #10 的 php -m 同时列出两者）。Dockerfile 仍保留 soft-fail 兜底，但 smoke 已把扩展缺失升级为硬 FAIL。

keys/jessie.gpg, vendor/*.tar.gz and vendor/SOURCES.json are produced once by scripts/vendor.sh --write (including dearmoring the Debian archive key) and then committed as frozen inputs; CI verifies every sha256 against vendor/SOURCES.json.

artifact layout (2026-11-08): self-contained. jessie-only sonames are enumerated via ldd and bundled into lib/; bin/php is a wrapper setting LD_LIBRARY_PATH to that dir, with the real ELF at libexec/php.bin; the glibc family is deliberately excluded so the host's newer libc is used. curl links GnuTLS (libcurl4-gnutls-dev) so it cannot collide with the vendored OpenSSL 1.0.2u over the shared libssl.so.1.0.0 soname.

SSL isolation contract (2026-11-08 L2): the vendored OpenSSL 1.0.2u serves ext/openssl only. Debian's libssl.so.1.0.0 exports versioned SSL_*@OPENSSL_1.0.0 symbols that upstream 1.0.2u lacks, so any jessie system library needing them must stay out of the final link line. Two measured cases: libcurl (switched to GnuTLS) and libpq (pdo_pgsql and libpq-dev removed after 40+ undefined references at link time). Legacy business projects are MySQL-only, and this is an offline migration tool, so trimming the frozen feature set beats mixing two SSL chains. scripts/test.sh T3b guards this.

support scope frozen 2026-11-08: 5.4 / 5.6 / 7.2 / 7.3 / 7.4 / 8.0 / 8.1+. All concrete branches are already EOL, so their last releases become a 7-version frozen closed set; 8.2+ rolls through the current channel. 3 Dockerfile templates (G1 5.x / G2 7.2-8.0 / G3 8.1+) cover the whole range. See support_matrix for sources and per-generation constraints. No new definition.toml, Dockerfile, sha256 or digest was invented in this change.

relocation fix (2026-11-08 L2): the first green build shipped redis.so, swoole.so and their conf.d ini files, yet smoke reported both extensions NOT loaded. Root cause was NOT a build failure: --with-config-file-scan-dir and extension_dir were compiled as absolute /opt/php/5.4.45 paths, so an unpacked artifact never scanned conf.d and could not resolve the .so files. scripts/relocate.sh now injects PHPRC, PHP_INI_SCAN_DIR and ASDF_PHP_PREFIX via bin/php / php-cgi wrappers, writes conf.d/00-relocatable.ini with extension_dir=${ASDF_PHP_PREFIX}/... (PHP 5.4 supports ${VAR} ini interpolation: Zend/zend_ini_parser.y:357 cfg_var_ref), and strips hardcoded prefixes from phpize / php-config / pear / pecl / peardev / phar. Dockerfile.5.4 runs a real relocation self-check (prefix moved to /opt/relocated, original path physically removed) before packaging; smoke-artifact.sh and CI turn relocation + extension checks into hard gates. Published 2026-11-08 as x-rush/asdf-php Releases tag php-5.4.45 (target branch v2) with sha256 21b9a98ab9cda5a23d65cd36e8be8b9a4548d05473e668a623eb45f59302f3b4; manifest status and versions.txt were updated only after the upload succeeded.
